CONTEXT.content: Design reviews align teams before code is written. Good review notes capture concerns, decisions, and action items — not endless debate.
CONTEXT.analogy: Court stenographer: records what was decided, not every argument.
CONTEXT.productionNote: Teams that skip written outcomes repeat the same discussions.
hints: Goal is decision or explicit follow-up, not perfection.

DECIDE.optionA: Async review: written doc, comments, 48h feedback window.
DECIDE.optionB: Sync review: 30-min meeting with live diagram walkthrough.

tradeoffs.A: Inclusive across timezones; slower for contentious decisions.

hints: What's the cost of delay vs cost of missing a voice?

BUILD.goal: Prepare a 1-page design review doc for a feature: problem, proposal, alternatives, open questions. Run a mock review and capture notes.

tracks.general: Use next feature on your app roadmap.

acceptance: Review notes: concerns raised, resolutions, action items
hints: Open questions are features, not failures.

criteria: Someone not in the review can understand the decision
Every concern is resolved or has an action item
No 'we'll figure it out later' without owner
hints: If notes don't change anything, the review was theater.

BREAK.scenario: Senior engineer vetoes approach in review but alternative isn't documented. Team builds original plan anyway.
BREAK.symptoms: Rework in week 3. 'We discussed this' with no paper trail.
hints: How do notes prevent silent disagreement?
Explicit approve / approve with concerns / reject

FIX.goal: Add decision status to notes. Document veto reason and chosen alternative with sign-off.
hints: Disagree and commit needs written record.

decisionCallbacks.A: Async doc would have preserved the veto even if meeting wasn't scheduled.
decisionCallbacks.B: Sync meeting surfaced concerns fast — but failed without written outcomes.
